# Internet Roadtrip - LLMs Guide

A chill and quirky multiplayer exploration game where you and travelers worldwide take a virtual road trip through Google Street View. Vote every 10 seconds and discover the world!

- Homepage: https://internetroadtrip.com/
- About Us: https://internetroadtrip.com/about-us
